verdict.rationale: The core Ramp spend-management platform is proprietary SaaS, and no evidence shows its source is available. Only peripheral first-party tooling is public: the Ramp CLI is described as "open-source" at github.com/ramp-public/ramp-cli, and a ramp-mcp repository README is publicly readable. missing for 10: source for the core Ramp product, an explicitly named open license (e.g. MIT/Apache) for any repo, independent corroboration of the CLI and MCP repos' licensing.
